sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Stacks to 100
- Only 10 can be brought into a raid
- Only 10 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time
- Spawns in stacks of 8-22

sections.heading: Quest rewards
sections.text:
- 2 can be obtained as a quest reward from Chumming
- 5 can be obtained as a quest reward from The Huntsman Path - Crooked Cop
- 20 can be obtained as a quest reward from The Huntsman Path - Relentless
- All quests from Ref provide varying amounts based on the player's Intelligence center level

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: - Easter eggs and References: GP is a reference to one of Battlestate Games' previous games "Contract Wars" in which GP (Gold Points) was the premium currency.
